fields.title: Kopra Yusō Ihō ni Kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku (Administrative Report on Copra Transport Breach)

report.subject: Haji Abdul Gani no yusō keiyaku ihan ni kansuru chōsa
report.author: Yamamoto Kenzo

fields.summary: Haikei yusō keiyaku ni motozuku wariawase ga jisshi sarezu, nōsanbutsu ga hōchi sareta mondai ni kansuru gyōsei chōsa hōkoku.
findings: Haikyō shisetsu no teishi to yusō senpaku no fuzoku ni yori keiyaku ihō ga hassei shita.
Shinseisha no seikyū wa keiyaku sho oyobi zaiko kiroku ni yori kanzen ni sata sarete iru.
recommendations: Kopra no yusō keiyaku fushitsu ni tai suru songai baishō no shiharai o kyoka suru.

claims.fact: Gyōsei hōkoku wa yusō keiyaku no ihan to songai no jijitsu o nintei shite iru.
